scenes.big: A Google Sheet is enough CRM for most clinics
scenes.say: Most small clinics don't need a CRM. A Google Sheet is enough, if you set it up right.
Log when it arrived, who it's from, the category, whether it's urgent, a one-line summary, and whether a reply went out.
scenes.caption: Log the category, urgency and a summary

scenes.title: The Status column
scenes.say: Then one status column staff update by hand: new, contacted, booked, not a fit. That's a pipeline.
scenes.caption: One Status column = a simple pipeline

scenes.sub: Clinic enquiry AI triage: workflow, setup guide and website form.
scenes.small: Works with n8n Cloud or self-hosted, and any OpenAI-compatible AI.
scenes.say: Want the free workflow? Check the link in my bio, or send me a message with the word flow.

post.caption:
Most small clinics don't need a CRM. A Google Sheet works if every enquiry is logged with category, urgency, a one-line AI summary and a Status column (New → Contacted → Booked → Not a fit). Keep access limited: enquiries can include health details.
